svg.title: COCONUT: The COlleCtion of Open Natural prodUcTs: deposit, curate and reuse natural product data. A specimen cabinet for natural products. An index card with menthol drawn on it rides from an intake pad along two rails under a curation stamp, which presses a pass mark on it; it drops through a filing slot, and the drawer of its parent structure, CNP0243697, slides out to show the card on top of that parent's stack of stereo variant cards.
